## LocalAsrCapabilities.latencyTier property

Rough perf tier on this user's hardware + model combo. Tools use this to decide whether to offer latency-sensitive features (live captions) or only offline use (post-hoc transcript). Not a benchmark — configured per Moss install, defaults to 'ok'.

**Signature:**

```typescript
latencyTier: 'fast' | 'ok' | 'slow';
```
